measurement.mode: Optical constants derived from multiple path-length transmission absorbance measurements
measurement.publisherProcessing: Multiple-path-length absorbance composites; reflective-loss correction; weighted linear fits; Kramers-Kronig calculation of n; source frequency correction already applied. Full sample-specific processing remains in original metadata PDF.
measurement.resolutionNote: Instrument resolution is 2.0 cm^-1; ~0.482 cm^-1 is the sampled grid after 4x zero filling, not improved instrument resolution.

source.citation: Myers et al., IARPA/PNNL Liquid Phase IR Spectra, March 2017; optical-constants methods: Appl. Spectrosc. 2018, 72, 535–550, DOI 10.1177/0003702817742848
